title: 彭博：芯片股反弹AI交易复苏
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So look, there's nothing that's really changed since our mid-year outlook.
segments.zh: 自年中展望以来，情况没有实质变化。

segments.en: You know, I think we still have this list of things that we think could present short-term tactical risks to the market, but we view those as things that might generate something
segments.zh: 我们仍认为存在一些短期战术风险，但最多引发5%到10%的回调。

segments.en: like a 5 to 10 percent draw down at worst. You know, those are things like the mid-term elections later this year. I know, you know, there's a lot of stories starting to percolate there and
segments.zh: 比如今年晚些时候的中期选举，客户兴趣也在升温。

segments.en: interest from clients starting to percolate as well. At some point, we'll deal with 2027 earnings growth expectations. We're not there yet. We're still sort of sorting through 2026,
segments.zh: 未来还需关注2027年盈利增长预期，但目前仍在消化2026年数据。

segments.en: but that's something to keep on your radar as well. And it feels like interest rate fears have eased back a little bit, but that's something also to keep on our radar. I know there's
segments.zh: 利率担忧有所缓解，但仍需警惕加息风险。

segments.en: just a whole range of outcomes predicted around the street right now. Some people looking for cuts, some people looking for hikes, but we do sort of keep that hike risk on the radar. But you know,
segments.zh: 市场对利率路径分歧很大，有人看降息，有人看加息。

segments.en: Tom, we really, with the price target, we try to be longer-term. We've recast it this year from a December 31st number to a 12-month forward number. We updated once a month. We did a little bit,
segments.zh: 我们的目标价更偏长期，今年改为12个月滚动预测，每月更新。

segments.en: you know, later last month, and we probably should have, but we had a number of events to get through.
segments.zh: 上月底我们本应更新，但因多项事件推迟。

segments.en: And so we upped our target a little bit to 81.50 healthy, not heroic. We still think that the earnings strength, the earnings tailwind, is offsetting pressures on the PE from the trickier rates and
segments.zh: 我们将目标小幅上调至81.50，健康但不激进。盈利增长抵消了利率和通胀对估值的压力。

segments.en: inflation environment. So no real change. What is the AI theme in your work these days? I guess we all started our own AI investing by just buying the chips, which is still a way to go, no doubt.
segments.zh: AI主题方面，最初通过买入芯片参与，这条路依然可行。
